genuinePriorKEEPRecord.reviewScope: exact inactive corrected PNG only, current bilingual goal/whole-profile/two-whole-case alignment and actual responsive orientation image
genuinePriorKEEPRecord.aiNotes: Full equation is end-group-correct and balanced: two dimethylsilanediol molecules give a disiloxane plus one water; Si four single bonds and bridge O two. It is a finite condensation example, not a claim of practical manufacture. Free oil chains versus visibly linked elastomer network agree with the supplied linear/crosslinked PDMS cases. Wetting explicitly says Chemie + Struktur; methyl surface groups are shown without claiming every silicone is a nanoparticle. At360 and316 the complete reaction and main oil/network/wetting distinctions remain readable; condensation formula no longer depends on an omitted-rest-group microcaption. At680 all model details are clear; actual paint height is below448 because this supplied asset is about16:9.
